properties.name: blocks.error.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the error handler library at all. When false, none of its handlers, advices or filters are registered.

properties.name: blocks.error.json.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register JsonExceptionHandler, which turns JSON deserialization failures into 400 responses.

properties.name: blocks.error.validation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register ValidationExceptionHandler, which turns @Valid/@Validated controller failures into 422 responses.

properties.name: blocks.error.constraint-violation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register ConstraintViolationExceptionHandler, which turns Bean Validation ConstraintViolationException into 422 responses.

properties.name: blocks.error.data.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register DataExceptionHandler, which turns data access exceptions into 404/409 responses.

properties.name: blocks.error.jpa.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register JpaEntityNotFoundExceptionHandler, which turns JPA EntityNotFoundException into 404 responses.

properties.name: blocks.error.global.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register GlobalExceptionHandler, which handles Spring MVC infrastructure exceptions and the 500 catch-all.

properties.name: blocks.error.trace.body.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register ProblemDetailTraceAdvice, which adds the 'traceId' property to error response bodies.

properties.name: blocks.error.trace.header.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register TraceIdResponseHeaderFilter, which adds the X-Trace-Id response header.
